summary: Successor to the v2 rework that removes the seeded renderer, executable lives, controller sandboxes, codecs, model organs, and all promotion paths. If and only if later ratified, the requested authority is exactly the three sorted scope_proposal.json atoms: pure_cpu_symbolic_alignment_enumerator, symbolic_golden_receipts, and symbolic_kernel_unit_and_property_tests. The five-node local DAG exhaustively proves or falsifies only the closed symbolic alignment, regime-posterior, twin, cost, bridge, projection, report, and scope invariants; every endpoint is declared and terminal.
system_thesis: The paper thesis remains Dream-LoRA-Think across growing action lifetimes, with later-outcome-grounded local claims, deterministic compilation, identical text/graph/LoRA content, bounded goal-conditioned reconstruction, held-out actions, explicit graph as a primary baseline, and LoRA credited only for transport/access. V3 does not test or authorize that thesis: it is a fast exact prerequisite asking whether a finite causal family has the intended information and action geometry before any rendered benchmark or learned system exists.
